_comment_general: PRINCIPLE algorithm config — PRogressive INterpolant with CG-Inner Preconditioned Langevin Estimation
_comment_langevin: num_langevin=S_k (Langevin steps per time point); h_x=step size for x1 ULA; h_epsilon=step size for epsilon ULA
_comment_regularization: lambda_x=ridge in WLS (Eq.9); lambda_reg=ridge in CG preconditioner P_k (step e); rho_s/rho_e=WLS weights for start/end endpoints (scalar or per-stage list)
_comment_cg: cg_tol=CG convergence tolerance; cg_max_iter=max CG iterations (used in both WLS and preconditioned ULA)
_comment_output: save_videos/save_dict_to_pt control output; record_every=record Langevin inner traj every N steps
_comment_operator: active_operator selects box/random; measurement_mode='measure' adds N(0,sigma_n^2) noise to y (consistent with likelihood 1/sigma_n^2 weight); 'call' gives noiseless y (use sigma_n≈0 or very small for noiseless inverse problem)
_comment_legacy: latent_update_mode kept for load_run_config validation; not used by PRINCIPLE algorithm
